subject: Security intake recap & request — SOC 2 Type II report and portal access
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@synergetichealth.com>
Cc: Jake Moreno <jake.moreno@synergetichealth.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security intake recap & request — SOC 2 Type II report and portal access

Hi Alicia — thanks again for the demo earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- Synergetic's priority: low-latency inference for clinical decision support and strict PHI controls (HIPAA).
- We covered hosted vs private (VPC) options; you mentioned procurement prefers hosted with a contractual DPA and evidence of SOC 2 Type II.
- Action items we agreed on: 
  1) You to share any vendor-vetted questionnaire fields (if you have a template)
  2) Redwood to provide current SOC 2 Type II report or bridge letter and grant temporary trust-portal access for artifact review
  3) Internal security touchpoint (Ben) will coordinate portal permissions and evidence handoff

For transparency, I can surface our SOC 2 Type II report and a short bridge letter while we complete the portal invite. Ben — looping you in to confirm what we can post to the trust portal and a target ETA. 

Proposed timeline: we can share the bridge letter and portal invite by EOD Wed (7/7) if that's workable from your side.

Next steps for Alicia/Procurement: please send your vendor questionnaire (if available) and confirm who should receive portal access (email list).

Thanks,
Rafael
Rafael Mendes | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
r.mendes@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0199

Attachment: demo-recording.mp4 (video link stub)
From: Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@synergetichealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@synergetichealth.com>, Jake Moreno <jake.moreno@synergetichealth.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Jul 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security intake recap & request — SOC 2 Type II report and portal access

Thanks Rafael — appreciate the recap. Quick answers:

- We'll send our standard vendor security questionnaire (VSQ) by EOD today.
- For portal access, please invite Alicia, Jake, and our procurement inbox (procurement@synergetichealth.com).
- Primary asks from procurement/security: copy of latest SOC 2 Type II (or statement if redacted), a bridge letter if the report is older than 12 months, and confirmation of PHI handling policies (HIPAA scope).

If you can get the bridge letter and temporary portal access by Wednesday that's perfect — procurement is coordinating an internal review next week.

Best,
Alicia
Alicia Torres
Head of Information Security
Synergetic Health
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@synergetichealth.com>, procurement@synergetichealth.com
Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2027 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Security intake recap & request — SOC 2 Type II report and portal access

Ben / Lauren — forwarding Synergetic's asks. Short summary and asks for security ops: 

- External request: SOC 2 Type II report (latest), bridge letter if needed, trust portal invite for 3 users (Alicia, Jake, procurement@synergetichealth.com).
- HIPAA/PHI scope note: customer explicitly called out PHI handling — please confirm which control domains we surface and whether a limited-attestation/attorney-redacted copy is appropriate.
- Timeline: Alicia wants portal access + bridge letter by EOD Wed (7/7) so procurement can kick off review next week.

Can you: 1) provide the bridge letter stub and confirm final attachment list; 2) send temporary portal invite (link) and set access to reviewers; 3) let me know if we need to route this through Legal for redactions before sending.

I can take point on the deal comms (deal D-49821). Alicia/procurement — we appreciate patience while we pull these artifacts together; Ben will send the invite directly.

Thanks,
Rafael
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@synergetichealth.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, procurement@synergetichealth.com
Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2027 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security intake recap & request — SOC 2 Type II report and portal access

Hi Alicia and team — looping back with artifacts and portal access details. Per Rafael's note: attached is our current SOC 2 Type II report (redacted where required) and a short bridge letter confirming continuous controls coverage since the report date.

Attachments:
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf (pdf, redacted copies)
- Redwood_Bridge_Letter_2027.pdf (pdf)

Temporary trust portal invite (reviewer access, expires 14 days):
https://redwood-trust.example.com/portal/INV-49821?token=eyJyaWQ9c2FtcGxl

Notes on HIPAA scope: Our Type II scope includes infrastructure, change management, logical access, and data loss prevention controls. PHI-specific processing runs under our Private deployment options and contractual DPA; for hosted customers we provide contractual commitments and operational evidence in the portal. If Synergetic requires on-prem or VPC-only handling of PHI, please flag and we will route to Solutions Engineering for an architecture review.

Next steps: 
- Alicia / Jake / Procurement: confirm you can access the portal link and whether you need an attorney-redacted PDF.
- Rafael / Lauren: I uploaded the two files above and set viewer permissions for the three external addresses. If Legal needs to redact further, let me know and I'll coordinate.

Ben Carter
Security Operations Lead | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
